excerpt: Experimental results from the HELIOS set-up (High Energy Lepton and Ion Spectrometer, in operation at the CERN Super Proton Synchrotron to study high-energy nucleus-nucleus collisions) are presented and discussed.
publisher: C. Leroy / Czechoslovak Journal of Physics 41 (1991) 36
title: Energy flow and multiplicity measurement in ultra-relativistic nucleus-nucleus collisions (C. Leroy, HELIOS results)
